Python test passes. Now I need to do the same for JS, Go, C#, Rust:
1. Apply GLB→compose transform when reading positions
2. Use Point/Vector (or equivalent) types for geometric fields
3. Use same formulas so numbers match
4. Serialize to same JSON shape (Point -> {x,y,z}) and compare to canonical

Let me start with Go. I need to read the Go implementation and add the transform, change GeometricInsights to use Point for BoundingBoxMin, BoundingBoxMax, Centroid, and optionally principal axes as []Vector. Then in the test, build the report dict in the same shape as Python (with Point/Vector as {x,y,z}) and compare to canonical. The canonical now has bounding_box_min as {"x", "y", "z"}, centroid same, principal_axes as [{"x","y","z"}, ...]. So Go needs to output that.
